intent: Generate four new chapter illustrations, preserve existing series identities and style, publish directly without visual review as requested.

images.caption: 能修，先看原来的
images.alt: 贾小鱼在紫色工坊中检查彭湃受损的蓝盾，将断木撑与修复材料图展示给小语。
images.after: 贾说得那么快，小语刚刚空下去的地方一下被填住。可她没有将盾立起拍两下，便说以后什么也不怕。她取出一片薄纸，画出框损与背带位置，分两项列材料。

Scene: Chapter 22, the open ordinary repair workshop on a sunlit stone alley in the layered fantasy city Yaohuan, on their first visit. Jia Xiaoyu is the adult female artisan from the purple character reference, distinct from Xiaoyu: dark violet-black tied-back hair, goggles above forehead, purple tailored practical workshop clothes with silver fittings, cream ruffled shirt, dark trousers, gloves and toolbelt. Xiaoyu is the adult woman at the front left of the party reference: shoulder-length wavy chestnut hair, tiny gold flower hairpin, blue cloak with ornate gold compass motifs and muted red lining, cream blouse and red necktie, brown travel trousers and boots. Her palm is lightly bandaged; she observes and speaks without heavy gripping.  The shield in reference 2 is the OBJECT reference only; its knight owner is recovering elsewhere and MUST NOT appear. Compose an intimate three-quarter medium-wide view across a worn wooden workbench. The original tall blue shield with faded gold heraldic dragon, dented rim and worn leather straps lies back-side partly toward camera on a padded low repair trolley. Jia shows one broken old wooden brace with a visibly blackened old crack; beside it she sketches the rim and strap repair and detachable mounting clasps on an unlettered thin paper. Xiaoyu leans in attentively with vulnerable relief turning to hope, bandaged hand resting relaxed rather than lifting the shield. Keep the blue shield face and gold crest visible at an oblique angle, no replacement pristine shield. Warm window sunlight on wood shavings, small hand tools, ordinary metal stock, a cracked kettle and stove lid on the far side table. The purple crystal tool chest stays CLOSED in the back; practical repair, no levitation or magical cure. Jia's confident gentle smile carries the moment of 'it can be repaired.' Two main figures only, tactile craftsmanship and quiet emotional warmth.

images.caption: 今日少搬两趟，也好
images.alt: 旧泵在工坊有限试验中流出清水，贾小鱼与顾霆守着接架，小语看着水桶逐渐接满。
images.after: 她语气很平，脸上的笑却比昨日接炉盖时更亮。阿榆拖过第二只空桶，搬运的人帮他换，小语站在侧面，给他们看脚下哪块干石能落脚。谁也没有让她用伤手抱起满桶，她竟第一次没觉得自己少做了什么。

Reference 3 defines Xiaoyu (blue cloak), Suxintang (red floral clothes), and the small dark teal feather-shaped relic; do not copy its wall altar scene or its black-haired male scholar. A compact aged brass-and-stone hand pump stands physically supported on the workbench beside a shallow waste tray and two ordinary wooden water buckets at its spout. One bucket nearly full, an apprentice in plain work clothes slides the second into position; Xiaoyu stands safely to the side pointing out the dry stone footing with her uninjured hand, delighted, not carrying a heavy bucket. Jia in purple watches the new fitted side-connector with a bright restrained smile. Gu Ting behind them guards the analog needle and the low marked power lever with a relaxed but attentive hand, never increasing the level. The dark teal feather relic, only a little wider than TWO PALMS, rests on a separate DRY supported cradle, connected to the pump by two short visible fitted plates on ordinary stone supports; only a tiny dim teal line lights on its side, no floating giant artifact, no wall-sized glow. One ordinary red-paper stabilizing talisman sits on the base, Suxintang in red stands nearby smiling with her hands released. On the right through the open doorway the neighboring laundry woman and white cloths in sunlight provide the destination of these two buckets. Clear continuous water catching golden highlights is the visual focus, an earned small success rather than an all-city miracle. Warm wide cinematic view, maximum five foreground figures, readable mechanical structure and luminous joy.

images.caption: 先让他过
images.alt: 晏执衡以两道细蓝弧稳住检修桥上端接臂并带工人脱险，顾霆在下端导流，小语从东口指明退路。
images.after: 晏没有回头看。他将工人推向东口，顾用杆将余弧拖离最后一块干石，贾的短工具也从侧面压下，重新落入冷位的接臂被普通锁销实实在在卡住。

Scene: Chapter 23 at the west narrow MAINTENANCE bridge of the city distribution rig, morning, a practical coordinated rescue. Yan Zhiheng is the adult male from his reference: tousled short ink-black hair, deep gray-blue eyes, pale face, matte black high-collar tactical coat with cool silver zipper, black belts and boots; calm precise concentration, a faint old scar at the thumb web. Reference 3 also gives Weikan, the adult brown-haired woman with a green/gold cloak and bow; her bow is set down and she uses an ordinary rescue rope. Wide cinematic dynamic diagonal composition, slightly above eye level showing the two dry stone steps to the east exit and old return channel BELOW the narrow maintenance platform, NOT a huge collapsing road bridge. Yan in matte black occupies center, keeping one hand at the exposed upper locking contact, two very fine controlled blue electrical arcs holding a descending metal articulated arm away; with his other hand he guides a terrified thin-faced adult maintenance worker by the back of his work jacket toward the two safe stone footholds. Worker is walking, not flying or carried through air; shoulder cloth slightly singed, no graphic injury. The metal arm is guided into an already cleared cold support seat at one side, not held up by Yan's body. Gu Ting in rolled sleeves braces his diversion rod at the LOWER contact off to one side, drawing the remaining thin blue current away from the stepping stones. Xiaoyu at the far eastern dry mouth points and calls the clear route, her bandaged hand not hauling anyone. Weikan steadies the ordinary rope tied to a real stone post, worker gripping it, no magic rope. A purple-clad female artisan just at the side uses a short pry tool and physical locking pin, only partly visible. A tipped tray and two dropped plain connector plates remain abandoned in a narrow gap, tools cleared from the escape route. Small precise blue arcs against warm brass and stone; faces, hands and feet readable. Heroism through exact teamwork, no lightning storm, fireball, mass ruin, army, wings, guns or giant magical shields. The relic and injured knight are absent.

images.caption: 停柄在自己手里
images.alt: 段禾亲手将本地停柄退到底，顾霆在旁指导，晏执衡将控制扣保留在复能侧，小语看见机关停稳。
images.after: 两处实物机关一前一后落到停位，上端的小指片也暗下去。晏看过响应，调整控制扣旁一根短接，第二次段禾再做，动作终于顺了。
